help: Save all of the font atlases currently in the font cache on the local drive. A timestamp will be automatically appended to the directory where the textures will be saved. The default location is YourProject/Saved/WidgetReflector/FontAtlases_Timestamp ie. WidgetReflector.DumpFontAtlases[SaveDirectory=<SaveDirectory>] [SaveFilePrefix=ExamplePrefix]
Take a snapshot and save the result on the local drive. ie. WidgetReflector.TakeSnapshot [Delay=1.0] [Navigation=false]
